article_content: The FBI has issued a public alert about a cybercrime group known as Scattered Spider, warning that this group has targeted dozens of American organizations over the past year, stealing sensitive data for extortion. The FBI and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) report that Scattered Spider uses convincing fake identities and employee impersonations to gain access to company systems, often by deceiving help desk staff. This cybercriminal gang was behind major breaches in September against casino operators MGM Resorts International and Caesars Entertainment, and experts note that their attacks have also affected sectors like telecommunications and healthcare. After infiltrating a network, the hackers monitor internal communication channels such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Exchange for indications that employees have noticed the intrusion. They even join security response meetings and calls to observe how defenders respond and to adjust their tactics. To help prevent further attacks, the FBI and CISA are advising critical infrastructure organizations to implement their recommended security measures and to share valuable information from incidents, such as ransom notes, communications with the hackers, cryptocurrency wallet details, or malicious file samples. Authorities also strongly discourage paying any ransom, stating that doing so does not guarantee that data will be recovered and could motivate the attackers to target additional organizations.

L'FBI e la Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) riportano che Scattered Spider utilizza false identità credibili e si finge personale interno per ottenere accesso ai sistemi aziendali, spesso ingannando gli operatori dell'help desk. FIFA announced Wednesday that soccer’s continental authorities have committed to supporting a single bid for the 2030 World Cup. What began as a Spain-Portugal proposal has grown to incorporate Morocco, as well as former competitor nations Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay. This unprecedented partnership marks the first World Cup to be staged across three continents, with opening matches planned for Montevideo, Uruguay—the same city that hosted the inaugural 1930 World Cup final at Centenario Stadium.

Alejandro Dominguez, CONMEBOL president, underscored the tournament’s historical significance: “The centenary World Cup couldn’t be separated from South America, where it all began. The 2030 cup will occur on three continents.”

Because of this collaborative agreement, FIFA has also begun the bidding process for the 2034 World Cup, open only to countries from Asia and Oceania. Both Saudi Arabia and Australia have expressed interest, with Australia recently hosting the Women’s World Cup alongside New Zealand. It is expected the 2034 tournament will also take place in November and December, similar to the 2022 event in Qatar.

Although FIFA’s Council has endorsed the unified 2030 bid, final approval must come from FIFA’s 211 member associations next year—a step widely considered a formality. FIFA president Gianni Infantino issued a statement praising the three-continent breakthrough, highlighting the involvement of Argentina, Morocco, Paraguay, Portugal, Spain, and Uruguay in welcoming the world to celebrate football’s centenary and the World Cup.

Scheduled for June-July 2030, the event will feature 48 teams and 104 matches. The opening games will be played in Uruguay, Argentina, and Paraguay, with the tournament then moving to Spain, Portugal, and Morocco. This will require an unusually large amount of transcontinental travel. Chile, previously part of the South American bid, was not mentioned in the current announcement, nor was Ukraine, who had once joined the European bid.

The next men’s World Cup in 2026 will be the first to host 48 teams, and will be jointly hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

article_content: Vivian Tu, a 29-year-old content creator, is the founder of the social-media brand Your Rich BFF. She began her professional journey in 2016 as an equities trader at J.P. Morgan. After her manager left the company, Vivian felt undervalued and decided to move into the tech and media industry, joining BuzzFeed in client partnerships. At BuzzFeed, coworkers frequently asked Vivian for financial advice—ranging from stock options to health insurance choices. To help more people, she started sharing financial tips online, initially without the intention of becoming a creator or influencer. Her first TikTok video, posted on January 1, 2021, quickly went viral and gained 100,000 followers within a week. The video's appeal lay in calling out poor or risky financial advice online and offering honest, practical guidance. Vivian told viewers, 'I don't have a get-rich-quick scheme, but if you want to learn more about money, I can certainly teach you.' Her content creator career evolved to include brand partnerships, hosting interviews, speaking at events, and launching a podcast, 'Networth and Chill.' She also received an advance for a personal finance book slated for publication by Penguin in December. In April 2022, Vivian left BuzzFeed—where she had worked for nearly four years—to focus on her brand, Your Rich BFF, full-time. Before quitting, Vivian planned financially, saving $100,000 from her corporate job to support herself during the transition. She emphasizes the importance of prudent planning before leaving a steady job, especially for those from immigrant families with traditional expectations. After going full-time, she hired an attorney and a manager, then signed with WME talent agency. These steps helped her scale her brand, increase her rates, and diversify projects, including her podcast and upcoming book. Vivian strives to be seen as an educator, not just an influencer, providing free, valuable content without selling courses or masterclasses. She builds connections by treating her audience like friends—calling them BFFs and interacting directly through messages. Her business now earns $3 million annually, with Vivian paying herself a $300,000 salary. She highlights the role of luck, strong branding, and audience engagement in her success. Consistency is key: she posts daily and advises other creators to stick to a sustainable schedule for lasting momentum.

article_content: Council workers accidentally removed a piece of modern art from a gallery window, mistaking it for graffiti. Contemporary artist Carrie Reichardt had painted a black anarchy symbol on the outside of Ink_d Gallery in Brighton, East Sussex, where her work was being exhibited. Overnight, Brighton and Hove City Council workers washed away the artwork, not realizing it was a deliberate piece, which upset Ms Reichardt. In response, Reichardt returned to Ink_d Gallery and repainted the anarchy symbol—this time in red and five times bigger. She expressed shock at the council's action, questioning whether it was legal for councils to remove art from private property. Reichardt criticized the removal as unduly heavy-handed, contrasting it with Brighton's liberal reputation. Dan Vaughan, the curator and director of Ink_d Gallery, reviewed CCTV footage to understand how the artwork, painted two weeks earlier, disappeared. He stated he is considering legal action against the council, describing Reichardt as an established contemporary artist and emphasizing the loss of valuable art. The council apologized for the incident and said it is investigating to prevent similar mistakes in the future. A similar situation occurred in 2007 when art by James Cauty was also removed from the gallery by mistake. The gallery director stressed the need for clear guidance from the council on what is permitted on gallery windows to avoid further incidents. A council spokeswoman explained the graffiti removal team did not realize the symbol was a work of art. She extended apologies to the artist and affirmed the council would review procedures to avoid such errors.

article_content: The Asian American Foundation (TAAF) and the Sundance Institute have announced the 2024 participants for the second edition of their joint initiative: the Sundance Institute | The Asian American Foundation Fellowship and Collab Scholarship. The program supports emerging and established AAPI artists in film and television through professional development, creative support, and community building, aiming to significantly increase Asian American and Pacific Islander representation in independent media. This year’s six fellows are Daniel Chein (“Time Hunter”), Justin Kim (“Dancing with Cranes”), Naomi Ko (“The 20-Year Curse”), Tee Jaehyung Park (“Cece’s Interlude”), Urvashi Pathania (“Skin”), and Jiayan “Jenny” Shi (working title: “Untitled Scientist Project”). Each fellow receives year-round mentorship, educational opportunities, creative and tactical support, and a $20,000 unrestricted grant. Recipients of the Collab Scholarship include Kristine Gerolaga (“Lamok”), Rahi Hasan (“Dhupshikha”), Quang Nong (“Baby Jackfruit Baby Guava”), Miles Orduña (“Death of the Great American Mall”), Betsy Tsai (“A Land of Long Shadows”), and Jackie! Zhou (“Rumspringa”). The scholarship offers a self-paced online course through Sundance Collab, personalized feedback on current work, and broad engagement with the Sundance community. Both fiction and nonfiction creators are supported. Hajnal Molnar-Szakacs, Director of the Sundance Artist Accelerator, stated, “We’re thrilled to continue uplifting Asian American and Pacific Islander voices through our partnership with TAAF. Last year’s fellowship and scholarship significantly supported new, diverse AAPI storytellers, and we look forward to this year's group.” Norman Chen, TAAF CEO, credited the MacArthur Foundation and Panda Express for ensuring AAPI artists have resources and mentorship to share their stories. Profiles of this year’s Fellows: Daniel Chein is a Berlin-, California-, and Taipei-based director and cinematographer whose debut feature, ‘Time Hunter,’ follows a revolutionary agent fighting colonial oppression with stolen technology. Justin Kim, a writer-director, explores loss, displacement, and nature in ‘Dancing with Cranes,’ a story intertwining characters from Korea, China, and Mongolia through the lens of the endangered red-crowned crane. Naomi Ko, a Korean American filmmaker, presents ‘The 20-Year Curse,’ a TV series about a family grappling with a generational curse, embarking on a journey through material and spiritual worlds. Tee Jaehyung Park’s ‘Cece’s Interlude’ features a documentary filmmaker chronicling Cece, a transgender, BIPOC nightlife figure and soon-to-be mother. Urvashi Pathania writes and directs ‘Skin,’ an elevated horror-thriller about two Indian American sisters facing the lure and danger of experimental skin bleaching technology. Jiayan “Jenny” Shi’s “Untitled Scientist Project” delves into the arrest of a Chinese American scientist amidst geopolitical tensions and the community’s response. Collab Scholarship Recipients: Kristine Gerolaga, Filipina American filmmaker, offers ‘Lamok,’ the story of a cursed woman who seeks redemption for her actions through underground abortions. Rahi Hasan’s ‘Dhupshikha’ centers on artistic and interpersonal liberation between a filmmaker and her poet mother as they battle societal oppression. Quang Nong’s ‘Baby Jackfruit Baby Guava’ portrays a dysfunctional family confronting their past through diaries as they face new motherhood. Miles Orduña’s ‘Death of the Great American Mall’ follows a Filipino American teenager adjusting to life in upstate New York after his family’s hardships during the COVID-19 pandemic. Betsy Tsai’s ‘A Land of Long Shadows’ follows a Belfast journalist investigating the epidemic of suicide among millennials in Northern Ireland. Jackie! Zhou’s ‘Rumspringa’ tells the story of an Asian American teen and her brother teaming up with Amish misfits to throw the party of a lifetime in Pennsylvania.

article_content: In recent years, Apple has made several significant changes to its iPhone lineup and related services. The latest announcement is that Apple will support Rich Communication Services (RCS) 'later next year,' a move seen as another step toward greater compatibility and openness. This follows the introduction of USB-C to the iPhone 15, widely attributed to the European Union's 'Common Charger' mandate. Notably, rumors and beta updates for iOS 17.2 also suggest Apple is preparing for app sideloading—again, a response to EU regulations, specifically the Digital Markets Act (DMA), which passed in July 2022 to ensure fair practices and restrict tech giants from acting as 'gatekeepers.' Apple’s planned RCS integration may appear as a customer-focused update, but many observers believe it’s primarily a strategy to comply with potential EU requirements and avoid legal challenges under the DMA. The debate over iMessage’s exclusivity has continued, with companies like Google lobbying for it to be classified as a 'core platform service' under EU law. Google, in particular, has campaigned for RCS adoption and issued a statement welcoming Apple’s decision, emphasizing the importance of secure and modern communication for all users. Recently, Nothing, a tech startup led by Carl Pei, announced it had sold over 2 million products and introduced 'Nothing Chat' to bring iMessage functionality to the Nothing Phone (2) in partnership with Sunbird, an app similar to Beeper. Although this initiative generated buzz, industry experts clarify that Apple’s move to RCS was not influenced by Nothing or its recent efforts. Instead, regulatory developments and pressure from larger players like Google played a bigger role. Security remains a concern for users trying third-party solutions like Sunbird and Beeper for cross-platform messaging. These apps can require connecting your Apple ID and personal phone number to a device you don’t control. Sunbird claims robust data protection practices, including ISO 27001 certification and ongoing work towards ISO 27701. However, entrusting sensitive data to remote servers still presents privacy risks, as highlighted by user experiences involving unexpected contact appearances and concerns over account access. While Apple maintains that iMessage will remain the leading messaging experience for Apple users, RCS adoption promises expanded device compatibility and feature parity between iOS and Android. Although this may not resolve the longstanding 'blue bubble vs. green bubble' cultural divide—especially among US teenagers, many of whom overwhelmingly prefer iPhones—it is widely seen as a positive step toward improved cross-platform communication. Outside the US, platforms like WhatsApp dominate messaging, making Apple’s exclusivity debate less relevant. Overall, Apple's decision to adopt RCS is another sign of the company’s response to external pressures, particularly from EU regulations, and a partial openness in its ecosystem that could benefit users globally.

article_content: Top Republican lawmakers criticized President Obama on Sunday, arguing he has not delivered on his promised bipartisan approach after Congress passed a substantial stimulus bill with minimal Republican support. Senators John McCain and Lindsey Graham expressed disappointment, pointing to the $787 billion recovery package—which only three Republican senators backed—as evidence that the administration’s start did not reflect the collaboration pledged during the campaign. On national news programs, Graham claimed that if this was considered bipartisanship, the nation faced serious issues. McCain, speaking on CNN, asserted that the process did not match promises made to the public about fostering open dialogues between both political parties. White House spokesman Robert Gibbs defended President Obama on CBS, highlighting multiple efforts to involve Republicans—such as meetings at the Capitol—and stated that the bill represents bipartisan steps to respond to the recession. McCain responded that outreach alone was insufficient, insisting that substantial negotiations, which integrate proposals from both parties, were missing and that most Republican suggestions were dismissed by party-line votes. McCain remained hopeful that upcoming economic measures would involve sincere bipartisan cooperation, acknowledging that past Republican leadership had also struggled with partisanship. Gibbs concluded by stressing Obama’s ongoing commitment to working across party lines and encouraging Republicans to join in these efforts.

article_content: Ghana's National Film Authority (NFA) will host its inaugural Africa Cinema Summit in Accra in partnership with Filmhouse Group (Nigeria) and Silverbird Cinema Ghana. The summit is scheduled for November 14-16 at the Mövenpick Ambassador Hotel and Silverbird Cinema, featuring partners like Warner Bros, Cinema Exhibitors Association of Nigeria, Century Cinemax, Ster-Kinekor, Icon Mann, UNESCO, and others. Top industry leaders will participate as speakers, including Juliet Yaa Asantewaa Asante (NFA CEO and summit convener), John Michael Schreiner (IMAX), Moses Babatope (Filmhouse Group), and Funmi Onuma (Silverbird Cinema, Ghana). Notable figures like Ope Ajayi, Rob Arthur, Marie Lora-Mungai, and Chief Alhassan Andani add further expertise from distribution, marketing, and creative industries. Highlights of the summit include screenings of contemporary African films, business matchmaking, panel sessions, keynote presentations, and networking opportunities tailored for industry professionals. Juliet Yaa Asantewaa Asante emphasized the importance of addressing critical challenges in Africa’s cinema sector, notably the need to expand cinema screens continent-wide. The summit is geared towards practical outcomes to strengthen African cinema. Featured speaker bios reflect distinguished careers: Asante’s industry leadership in Ghana; Babatope’s extensive film sector experience; Onuma’s record-breaking achievements in cinema management; Schreiner’s executive role at IMAX; Lora-Mungai’s pan-African creative advisory; Ajayi's expertise in distribution and finance; Arthur’s decades in global cinema; Micah’s East African marketing leadership; Ochai’s work in creative economies; Matsau’s strategy at Ster-Kinekor; Sewankambo’s communications leadership in Uganda; and Andani’s corporate and banking background.

article_content: The oldest known fossilized evidence of two insects mating, dating back more than 165 million years, has been discovered in China. Researchers believe the pair were engaged in copulation when they were killed by toxic gases released from a volcanic eruption. The wind then carried their bodies into a lake, where they were buried under sediment and preserved for millions of years. A research team from Capital Normal University in China uncovered the remarkably well-preserved specimen in the Daohugou region of Inner Mongolia. The insects remain interlocked, with both sets of genitals clearly visible. The mating position of these fossilized insects resembles that of modern froghoppers, which typically mate facing each other while clinging to a twig, or side-by-side on a leaf or tree trunk. The fossilized male's abdomen is twisted to facilitate copulation, a trait also seen in living species. These insects are identified as members of the Anthoscytina perpetua species. In the fossil, the male (on the right) is seen with his sex organ inserted into the female (on the left). According to study co-author Chung Kun Shih, fossils of copulating insects are rare, with only about 40 found worldwide. This discovery surpasses the age of previously known examples by approximately 65 million years. Study author Dong Ren noted, 'We found these two very rare copulating froghoppers, providing a glimpse into ancient insect behavior and valuable data about mating positions and genitalia orientation during the Middle Jurassic era.' He added that the discovery suggests froghoppers' genital symmetry and mating position have remained unchanged for over 165 million years. Due to the rarity of such fossils, little is known about ancient insect mating behavior and the evolution of genital anatomy. This find significantly expands that knowledge. The team examined over 1,200 specimens from the Daohugou locality. The Daohugou Bed is part of the Tiaojishan Formation—a rock unit in Hebei and Liaoning, China—believed to date back to the middle to late Jurassic period. The discovery and findings have been published in the journal PLOS ONE.
translated_content: La più antica prova fossile conosciuta di due insetti in accoppiamento, risalente a oltre 165 milioni di anni fa, è stata scoperta in Cina. I ricercatori credono che la coppia stesse copulando quando fu uccisa dai gas tossici emessi da un'eruzione vulcanica. Il vento trasportò poi i loro corpi in un lago, dove vennero sepolti sotto il sedimento e conservati per milioni di anni. Un team di ricerca della Capital Normal University in Cina ha scoperto l’esemplare eccezionalmente ben conservato nella regione di Daohugou, in Mongolia Interna. Gli insetti sono ancora interconnessi, con entrambi gli apparati genitali chiaramente visibili. La posizione d’accoppiamento di questi insetti fossili assomiglia a quella delle moderne cicaline, che normalmente si accoppiano faccia a faccia su un rametto, oppure uno accanto all’altro su una foglia o sul tronco di un albero. L’addome del maschio fossilizzato è attorcigliato per facilitare la copulazione, una caratteristica presente anche nelle specie attuali. Questi insetti sono stati identificati come appartenenti alla specie Anthoscytina perpetua. Nel fossile, il maschio (a destra) è visibile mentre inserisce l’organo sessuale nella femmina (a sinistra). Secondo Chung Kun Shih, coautore dello studio, i fossili di insetti copulanti sono rari—ne sono stati trovati solo circa 40 in tutto il mondo. Questa scoperta supera l’età degli esempi precedentemente conosciuti di circa 65 milioni di anni. L’autore dello studio Dong Ren ha affermato: “Abbiamo trovato questi due rarissimi fossili di cicaline in accoppiamento, che offrono uno sguardo sul comportamento degli insetti antichi e dati importanti sulla posizione durante l’accoppiamento e sull’orientamento degli organi genitali nel Giurassico medio”. Ha aggiunto che la scoperta suggerisce che la simmetria genitale e la posizione durante l’accoppiamento delle cicaline sono rimaste invariate per oltre 165 milioni di anni. A causa della rarità di tali fossili, si sa poco sul comportamento riproduttivo degli insetti antichi e sull’evoluzione dell’anatomia genitale. Questa scoperta amplia notevolmente tali conoscenze. Il team ha esaminato oltre 1.200 esemplari dalla località di Daohugou. Il giacimento di Daohugou fa parte della Formazione Tiaojishan—un’unità rocciosa tra Hebei e Liaoning, in Cina—che si ritiene risalga al periodo Giurassico medio-tardo. La scoperta e i risultati sono stati pubblicati sulla rivista PLOS ONE.

article_content: More than 300,000 police officers and soldiers were deployed to secure polling stations across over 42,000 villages as millions of Filipinos voted for village leaders. At least three people were killed in the southern Philippines amid heightened tensions following months of election-related violence. On Monday, security forces were on high alert for the nationwide vote for more than 336,000 local council positions. Village, or barangay, posts represent the lowest unit of government but are intensely contested, as political parties use them to establish grassroots networks ahead of local and national elections. Elections are a particularly volatile period in the Philippines due to lax gun laws and a political culture prone to violence. According to police, two people died and five others were wounded on Monday in a shootout outside a polling station in Maguindanao del Norte province, on Mindanao island. The clash involved supporters of rival candidates for village captain, confirmed Lieutenant-Colonel Esmail Madin of Datu Odin Sinsuat municipality. In a separate incident in Lanao del Norte province, the army reported that a woman was killed when gunfire broke out after a van carrying a village captain and supporters was blocked by rival backers. In the capital, Manila, voters lined up at schools serving as polling sites. "This is important for us because we need someone to consult about our problems," said Rosemarie Garcia, a voter in Tondo. "We need leaders who are accessible to their constituents." Back in 2009, before Maguindanao was split into two provinces, the area saw the country's deadliest act of political violence: 58 people were killed when armed men linked to a local strongman attacked a group to stop a rival's election nomination. Ahead of Monday's vote, the Philippine National Police reported 30 confirmed election-related violent incidents, down from 35 in 2018, though details on casualties were not updated. Roughly one-third of these incidents took place in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Mindanao. Police records showed eight deaths and seven injuries from violence between August 28 and October 25. Over 67 million Filipinos are registered to vote. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. described this election as 'very important' for higher-level politicians, explaining that results at the barangay level can influence future local and national elections. After voting in Batac City, Ilocos Norte, Marcos stated, 'If other barangays tell you they will deliver 350 votes, you can expect to get that number.' Voters are choosing a village captain and seven councillors, who handle national policy implementation, resolve local disputes, and provide basic services. Barangay councils also allow politicians to distribute resources and favors in exchange for political support, noted Maria Ela Atienza, political science professor at the University of the Philippines. Though these elections should be held every three years, the last vote took place in 2018, having been postponed by former President Rodrigo Duterte and then by President Marcos on financial grounds.

I ruoli di villaggio, o barangay, rappresentano la più bassa unità di governo ma sono fortemente contesi, poiché i partiti politici li usano per costruire reti di base in vista delle elezioni locali e nazionali. Le elezioni sono un periodo particolarmente instabile nelle Filippine a causa delle leggi permissive sulle armi da fuoco e di una cultura politica incline alla violenza. Secondo la polizia, due persone sono morte e altre cinque sono rimaste ferite lunedì in una sparatoria fuori da un seggio elettorale nella provincia di Maguindanao del Norte, sull’isola di Mindanao. Nella capitale, Manila, gli elettori hanno fatto la fila nelle scuole utilizzate come seggi. “Questo è importante per noi perché abbiamo bisogno di qualcuno con cui consultarsi per i nostri problemi,” ha detto Rosemarie Garcia, elettore di Tondo. “Abbiamo bisogno di leader che siano accessibili ai loro elettori.” Nel 2009, prima che Maguindanao fosse divisa in due province, la zona fu teatro del più grave episodio di violenza politica del paese: 58 persone furono uccise quando uomini armati legati a un boss locale attaccarono un gruppo per impedire la candidatura di un rivale. Prima del voto di lunedì, la Polizia Nazionale filippina ha registrato 30 episodi violenti collegati alle elezioni, un calo rispetto ai 35 del 2018, anche se non sono state aggiornate le cifre su morti e feriti. Circa un terzo di questi incidenti si è verificato nella Regione Autonoma Bangsamoro di Mindanao. I dati della polizia riportano otto morti e sette feriti tra il 28 agosto e il 25 ottobre. Oltre 67 milioni di filippini sono registrati al voto. Il presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ha definito queste elezioni 'molto importanti' per i politici di livello superiore, spiegando che i risultati a livello di barangay possono influenzare le future elezioni locali e nazionali. Dopo aver votato a Batac City, Ilocos Norte, Marcos ha dichiarato: 'Se altri barangay vi promettono 350 voti, potete essere certi di riceverli.' Gli elettori scelgono un capitano di villaggio e sette consiglieri, che si occupano dell’attuazione delle politiche nazionali, della risoluzione delle controversie locali e della fornitura di servizi di base. I consigli di barangay permettono anche ai politici di distribuire risorse e favori in cambio di appoggio politico, ha sottolineato Maria Ela Atienza, docente di scienze politiche presso l’Università delle Filippine. Sebbene queste elezioni dovrebbero tenersi ogni tre anni, l’ultima votazione si è svolta nel 2018, dopo essere stata rinviata prima dall’ex presidente Rodrigo Duterte e poi dal presidente Marcos per motivi finanziari.

article_content: President Joe Biden on Sunday stated that Hamas should be eliminated entirely, while also emphasizing the need for a pathway to establishing a Palestinian state. In a '60 Minutes' interview aired Sunday, Biden reaffirmed his condemnation of Hamas' surprise terrorist attacks on Israel that took place on October 7. According to Israel's Prime Minister's office, the death toll has reached approximately 1,400 people as of Sunday. "We have to communicate to the world: This is critical. This is not even human behavior. It's pure barbarism," Biden said. When asked by 60 Minutes correspondent Scott Pelley if he believed Hamas should be eliminated entirely, Biden replied, "Yes, I do. But there needs to be a Palestinian authority. There needs to be a path to a Palestinian state." The president referenced the 'two-state solution,' a proposal for two independent states — Israel and Palestine. However, Biden acknowledged that Israel would not be open to the solution in the wake of last week's attacks, adding his belief that Israel recognizes that a significant portion of Palestinian people do not share the views of Hamas or Hezbollah, a Shiite Muslim political and military group in Lebanon.

Secondo l'ufficio del Primo Ministro israeliano, il bilancio delle vittime ha raggiunto circa 1.400 persone alla data di domenica. "Dobbiamo comunicarlo al mondo: è fondamentale. Questo non è neanche comportamento umano. È pura barbarie", ha detto Biden. article_content: Bayern Munich has demonstrated their financial strength by paying off the Allianz Arena debt an extraordinary 16 years early. Club chairman Karl-Heinz Rummenigge confirmed that the team repaid the entire €346 million loan—borrowed in 2005 to build the stadium—in just nine years instead of the planned 25, originally meant to last until 2030. Rummenigge expressed immense pride in this early accomplishment. In comparison, Arsenal undertook a similar project to fund their Emirates Stadium, which opened in 2006. Despite holding over £200 million in cash reserves, Arsenal continues to pay approximately £35 million annually as part of their stadium debt. The club opts to use its cash reserves primarily for player transfers and operational expenses rather than clearing the debt. The Allianz Arena, accommodating 71,137 spectators, has been solely owned by Bayern Munich since 2006, after purchasing the remaining share from 1860 Munich—though 1860 Munich retains the right to play matches there. A notable feature is the stadium’s lighting: it glows red for Bayern matches and blue when 1860 Munich plays. While Arsenal’s net stadium debt is around £30 million, they maintain significant annual payments. In recent European competitions, Bayern Munich and Arsenal have faced each other multiple times.

article_content: A significant number of OpenAI employees have threatened to leave the company following the abrupt firing of co-founder Sam Altman. In a letter, some of OpenAI’s most senior staff members demanded the board’s replacement, stating they would resign if it did not happen. The letter, first reported by Wired, criticized the board’s decision to terminate Altman and remove co-founder and former president Greg Brockman, stating these actions undermined OpenAI’s mission and stability. Altman, who helped lead OpenAI to prominence with products like the ChatGPT chatbot, announced he would launch a new artificial intelligence (AI) subsidiary at Microsoft after his departure. Microsoft reportedly assured OpenAI employees that they could join Altman’s new team. As many as 500 of OpenAI’s 770 employees are said to have signed the protest letter. The board’s decision to remove Altman was reportedly linked to concerns about managing the risks of AI technology, though Emmett Shear, appointed as the interim CEO and former head of Twitch, denied that safety fears were the reason for Altman’s removal. Following Altman’s exit, several other notable staff members also left, and investors expressed their opposition, calling for his reinstatement. Nevertheless, OpenAI’s board maintained its position, citing issues with transparency. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella confirmed on X (formerly Twitter) that Altman and Brockman would join Microsoft to lead a new advanced AI research team. He reiterated Microsoft’s ongoing commitment to its partnership with OpenAI. Microsoft has invested over $10 billion in OpenAI and integrated its technology into various products. Altman later stated that his priority, along with Nadella’s, remains ensuring OpenAI’s continued success.

article_content: The U.S. Justice Department has accused Russian national Evgeniy Mikhailovich Bogachev of leading the group responsible for the sophisticated Gameover Zeus malware. Experts warn that this dangerous cyber threat may have infected thousands of American computers and could be lying dormant, collecting data. According to the FBI, Gameover Zeus has compromised between 500,000 and one million computers worldwide, resulting in victims losing tens of millions of dollars. The malware is known for its ability to evade anti-virus programs. It typically infects users when they open a malicious PDF or click on an infected email link. Once installed, it intercepts and modifies financial transactions, redirecting funds to criminals' accounts. It also disguises unauthorized payments, making thefts difficult to detect. Nick Savvides, senior principal systems engineer at cybersecurity firm Symantec, described the malware as highly sophisticated: 'It keeps track of balances; it automatically corrects the numbers on the balance. It's so sophisticated that it hides its tracks.' The highest number of incidents have been reported in the U.S. (13%) and Italy (12%), with 7% occurring in the UK. Savvides noted that many users might have unknowingly downloaded the malware, which could remain dormant until activated. Often, computers infected with Gameover Zeus are also targeted by a related malware called Cryptolocker, used when attackers cannot access a victim's financial details. Cryptolocker locks the computer, encrypts files, and demands a ransom—usually about one Bitcoin (around $500)—to unlock the data. Symantec reports that 3% of victims pay to recover their files. At least one U.S. police force reportedly paid a $750 ransom to regain access to sensitive files. An international police operation led by the FBI and Symantec recently disrupted Gameover Zeus. However, the network could be operational again within two weeks, so users are strongly advised to secure their systems immediately. Gameover Zeus is especially difficult to dismantle because of its peer-to-peer structure, letting infected computers communicate even if central servers are shut down. The malware is linked to more than $100 million in losses from individuals and major companies. Bogachev is wanted by U.S. authorities and faces several charges, including conspiracy, computer fraud, wire fraud, bank fraud, aggravated identity theft, and money laundering. He is described as a white male with brown eyes (head usually shaved), about 5 feet 9 inches tall and weighing approximately 180 pounds (82 kg). His last known residence was in Anapa, Russia, and he may travel along the Black Sea by boat. He also owns property in Krasnodar, Russia. Users are advised to install updated anti-virus software, change passwords, enable automatic updates, avoid suspicious emails, and back up crucial data. Many infected users will be contacted by their internet service providers, and Symantec provides a clean-up tool. There is a short window before hackers might rebuild the malicious network, so immediate action is essential.

article_content:
Former News International chief executive Rebekah Brooks was questioned by police today regarding alleged payments to Ministry of Defence officials. Brooks, who previously edited The Sun, was reportedly asked about evidence submitted by News Corporation's Management and Standards Committee.

The 41-year-old was first arrested in July on suspicion of phone hacking and corruption, shortly after resigning from News International. Last week, she was re-arrested along with her husband, racehorse trainer Charlie Brooks, on suspicion of conspiracy to pervert the course of justice. In connection with the investigation, police searched several properties in Oxfordshire, London, Hampshire, and Hertfordshire. Four additional suspects were also detained.

Her lawyer, Stephen Parkinson, recently commented that testimony from Metropolitan Police Deputy Assistant Commissioner Sue Akers at the Leveson Inquiry had introduced 'much prejudicial material' into the public domain.

In recent weeks, Brooks' relationships with senior police officers and politicians have faced scrutiny after revelations that she fostered a retired police horse in 2008. She covered the horse’s food and veterinary expenses until it was rehoused with a police officer in 2010, a few months before new investigations into alleged illegal activities at the News of the World began.

According to Scotland Yard, a total of 22 people have been arrested under Operation Weeting, the Metropolitan Police’s investigation into phone hacking, which reopened in January last year.

Brooks was born on May 27, 1968, and grew up in Warrington, Cheshire. She studied briefly at the Sorbonne in Paris before returning home and starting her media career as a secretary at Eddie Shah's Messenger Group. She quickly advanced to reporting roles, then moved to the News of the World's Sunday magazine. Her longstanding association with News International led her to The Sun in 1998, and in 2000 she became editor of News of the World at age 31. In 2003, she was appointed as the first female editor of The Sun and, in 2009, became chief executive of News International.

article_content: Bevan Meninga, who spent over twenty years in prison for the 1991 murder of Cheree Richardson on the Sunshine Coast, was released this week. His parole was reportedly influenced by a heartfelt letter from his teenage daughter, conceived during Bevan's relationship with a prison officer while incarcerated. As the brother of rugby league legend Mal Meninga, Bevan had the ongoing support of his family. Mal has emphasized they do not forgive the crime but stand ready to help him reintegrate and contribute positively to society. Bevan is now expected to live in Brisbane with his mother, who relocated from the Sunshine Coast before his release. In addition to moving, Bevan's release is subject to strict parole conditions, including regular drug and alcohol testing and being barred from residing on the Sunshine Coast, where the victim’s family remains. The 1991 murder of Cheree Richardson, then 19, left the Sunshine Coast community in shock. Bevan was sentenced to life imprisonment for her death; at the time, he was already on parole for another violent offense. Queensland Premier Campbell Newman stated he hopes Bevan's family and friends support his rehabilitation, acknowledging Bevan has served his sentence for a serious crime. Cheree Richardson's parents, John and Helen, reportedly left the area to avoid renewed media focus after Bevan's release. Community sentiment remains mixed over his return to public life. Located about 100 kilometers south of Brisbane, Palen Creek Correctional Centre oversees more than 170 low-security male prisoners. Bevan's release followed years of legal procedures, family advocacy, and his daughter's important testimony.

article_content: LinkedIn has reported a major upswing in job postings that reference artificial intelligence (AI) skills, starting from 2021 onward. Their recent survey, which reached almost 30,000 professionals from the US, UK, Canada, and several additional countries, confirms this pattern. The LinkedIn Global Talent Trends Report—tracking job postings in ten different languages—found a notable increase in roles highlighting AI or generative AI. The report predicts significant changes in required skills by 2030, driven by rapid developments such as increased AI adoption. The platform's data shows that global postings mentioning AI or generative AI have more than doubled over the past two years. Applications for these positions are also rising, with a 17% faster growth rate compared to other jobs. Enthusiasm for AI is strong: 89% of surveyed professionals are excited about integrating AI in their work, and 57% want to further develop their AI skills. Interest in AI spiked after the launch of ChatGPT by OpenAI in November 2022, which rapidly achieved 100 million users in just over two months. This trend is visible across job platforms. For instance, Adzuna listed 1,496 open US roles mentioning generative AI out of 7.8 million postings in May—up from 185 in January and just three in May the previous year. AI-related jobs are often lucrative, with many positions paying above $100,000 yearly. Noteworthy examples include a machine learning researcher at Jane Street (paying $250,000–$300,000) and a senior machine learning engineer at Disney ($145,400–$199,870 per year).

article_content: A couple in Guangzhou, the capital of Guangdong Province in southeast China, experienced an unexpected childbirth on a city pavement. While on their way to the hospital, the woman suddenly went into labor and collapsed, unable to continue. With the baby crowning and the hospital still far away, the husband sought help from a nearby dental clinic, but the dentists explained that they were not trained to deliver babies. Local residents quickly provided coats and sheets, and the husband delivered the baby himself, encouraged by bystanders. The baby was born safely before an ambulance arrived to take the family to the hospital for further care. An onlooker remarked that the woman could not hold the baby in any longer, so her husband did what was necessary using the materials provided.

article_content: Danika Heron, a 19-year-old apprentice chef who recently moved to Sydney from Nowra, suffered a life-threatening allergic reaction to newly prescribed epilepsy medication. The initial symptoms—a small rash on her chest—appeared on her 19th birthday and quickly spread, worsening over four days. Despite seeking help at a Sydney hospital three days in a row, Danika was repeatedly misdiagnosed and sent home, even as her condition deteriorated with blistering rashes, swollen eyes, and ulcerated lips. After her mother traveled from Nowra to intervene, Danika was brought to a local hospital and diagnosed with Stevens-Johnson syndrome, a severe reaction often triggered by medications. However, she was again discharged. On the fourth day, when she could no longer breathe or swallow properly, she returned to hospital, where a critical care doctor recognized the severity of her illness and arranged for her immediate transfer to Concord Hospital in Sydney. Further testing revealed she had toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), a rare but extremely dangerous skin disorder. Dr. Saxon Smith, president of the NSW branch of the Australian Medical Association, explained that TEN affects about one in 500,000 people each year, with a mortality rate around 30%. Most cases are caused by reactions to medications. Danika spent three weeks in hospital, treated as a burns patient and wrapped in silver dressing. Six weeks after her initial symptoms, she is recovering at home, requiring eye exams every two weeks due to the risk of blindness, still experiencing pain, nail loss, and scarring. Danika and her family have filed a formal complaint regarding her delayed diagnosis and treatment. She is now recovering slowly, grateful to be home and looking forward to returning to work.

I primi sintomi—una piccola eruzione cutanea sul petto—sono comparsi il giorno del suo compleanno e si sono rapidamente diffusi, peggiorando nel corso di quattro giorni. Nonostante si sia recata in ospedale a Sydney per tre giorni di seguito, Danika è stata ripetutamente dimessa con diagnosi errate, mentre le sue condizioni continuavano a peggiorare con vesciche, occhi gonfi e labbra ulcerate. Dopo che la madre è arrivata da Nowra per intervenire, Danika è stata portata in un ospedale locale dove le è stata diagnosticata la sindrome di Stevens-Johnson, una grave reazione spesso causata da farmaci. Tuttavia, è stata nuovamente dimessa. Il quarto giorno, quando respirare e deglutire era diventato quasi impossibile, è tornata in ospedale, dove un medico di terapia intensiva ha riconosciuto la gravità della situazione e ha organizzato il suo trasferimento urgente al Concord Hospital di Sydney. Ulteriori esami hanno rivelato che soffriva di necrolisi epidermica tossica (TEN), un raro ma pericolosissimo disturbo della pelle. Il dottor Saxon Smith, presidente della sezione del New South Wales dell’Australian Medical Association, ha spiegato che il TEN colpisce circa una persona su 500.000 ogni anno, con un tasso di mortalità attorno al 30%. La maggior parte dei casi è dovuta a reazioni ai farmaci. Danika ha trascorso tre settimane in ospedale, trattata come una paziente ustionata e avvolta in speciali bende argentate. Sei settimane dopo i primi sintomi, si sta riprendendo a casa, deve fare controlli agli occhi ogni due settimane per il rischio di cecità, e continua a soffrire di dolori, perdita delle unghie e cicatrici. Danika e la sua famiglia hanno presentato un reclamo formale per la diagnosi e il trattamento tardivi. Ora si sta riprendendo lentamente, è grata di essere a casa e spera di tornare presto al lavoro.

article_content: Popular TikTok creator Nikita Redkar, known as @nikitadumptruck, is facing backlash after posting a video in which she attempted to explain the Israel-Palestine conflict using a lighthearted analogy. In the now-deleted video, Redkar described the historical dispute through the story of a girl named 'Patty' having a birthday party, which is interrupted when 'Brittany' announces that 'Izzy' will celebrate her birthday at the same location. These characters represented Palestine, Great Britain, and Israel, respectively. The video, posted several days after Hamas's attack on Israel, was met with strong criticism online. Many viewers felt that Redkar's use of simplified, playful language trivialized a serious and sensitive issue. Comments across stitched and re-uploaded versions of the video expressed frustration, with some users stating that complex geopolitical issues should not be 'dumbed down' for easier understanding. A number of commenters also used the skull emoji to signal disbelief or disapproval. Redkar, who is known for breaking down complex topics 'for the girls' with casual, conversational language, offered an apology. She explained that her intent is to make difficult subjects more accessible to her audience, but admitted her usual comedic style was not suitable given the severity of the ongoing conflict. 'Part of what I missed was the impact on Palestinian lives, and that couldn't be portrayed through a birthday party analogy,' she acknowledged. Despite her apology, many commenters found it lacking, characterizing it as 'surface level' and critiquing her continued use of 'bimbo comedy' in this context. Some also questioned whether the 'girlsplaining' approach was ever appropriate for discussing significant global issues. More broadly, commenters reflected on a wider trend: the societal preference for quick, accessible information, sometimes at the cost of depth or sensitivity. Redkar is not alone in facing consequences for her commentary on the conflict. Some companies have rescinded job offers from students accused of antisemitism after making statements about Israel and Hamas, and several universities have lost donor funding due to perceived inadequate responses to the conflict. Redkar did not respond to Insider’s request for comment.

article_content: A group of contract workers responsible for training Google's Bard AI chatbot and writing Google Help articles have overwhelmingly voted to unionize. These workers, employed by Accenture under contract with Google, formed the union to advocate for better working conditions and protections. They are joining the Alphabet Workers Union, which represents employees at Google and its parent company, Alphabet. The unionization initiative began in June when workers were assigned to help train the then-unannounced Bard chatbot. This involved handling objectionable and potentially offensive prompts, according to a Bloomberg report. When a contractor raised concerns about the nature of the work with Accenture's human resources, some of these tasks were transferred to Accenture staff in Manila. Shortly after announcing plans to unionize, dozens of contractors were laid off, reducing the team from approximately 120 to about 40 workers. Jen Hill, a Google Help designer and union member, stated, 'We organized so that we could have a say in our working conditions. In response, Google has tried to avoid its responsibility as our employer, while also laying off many of our colleagues.' Contractors assert that both Google and Accenture act as joint employers and should both be accountable for their treatment. Google, however, maintains that it is not a direct employer. 'We have no objection to these Accenture workers electing to form a union. We’ve long had many contracts with unionized suppliers,' said Google spokesperson Courtenay Mencini to The Verge. 'However, as we stated in our appeal to the NLRB (National Labor Relations Board), we are not a joint employer, as we do not control their employment terms or working conditions—this is between the workers and Accenture.' In their appeal to the NLRB, Google emphasized that Accenture alone determines schedules, job classifications, leave requests, and pay. Accenture spokesperson Deirdre Blackwood acknowledged the 'right of our people to form or join unions' and confirmed the company would participate in the NLRB process. Google has faced criticism over its treatment of contract workers for years, and unionization efforts among contractors at the company are increasing. In April, a group of YouTube Music contractors voted to unionize, with the NLRB ruling that Alphabet should be recognized as a joint employer—a decision that would require Google to participate in contract negotiations. However, the NLRB says Google has so far refused to negotiate with these workers. With Google continuing to contest claims that it is a joint employer for Accenture workers, the situation signals the likelihood of legal challenges ahead.

article_content: Llamas, known for their temperamental and territorial behavior, are now being used by UK farmers as an innovative way to combat countryside crime. Traditionally used in South America to guard goats and sheep from predators, these alert animals are now being enlisted by British farmers to help deter criminals. A survey by the insurance company NFU Mutual found that llamas are among the more unusual security measures employed by its members to protect valuable property. Last year, farm thefts in the UK cost £52.7 million, an annual increase of six percent, according to the company. Other improvised methods of securing farmland include keeping noisy flocks of geese to alert homeowners and storing expensive equipment, like quad bikes, in pens protected by Friesian bulls. However, llamas are considered the most novel form of security identified by the survey. Llamas are related to camels and have long been valued in the Americas for defending other livestock. Highly attentive to their surroundings, they respond to intruders—whether human or animal—by making loud alarm calls. If necessary, llamas may chase and even attack trespassers with kicks and bites. There are even reports of llamas killing predators as large as dogs or coyotes. While no incidents have been recorded of llamas stopping farm robbers in the UK, a survey of NFU Mutual branch offices revealed that over three quarters of respondents felt concerns about rural crime had increased in the past year. Many farmers are taking extra precautions, such as installing CCTV, locks, and alarms, but these can be costly, especially in tough economic times. Most survey participants (71 percent) said that the majority of rural thefts were planned, typically carried out under cover of darkness. The survey identified high-value items such as power tools, heating oil, red diesel, and quad bikes as prime targets for thieves. There is a growing trend of theft of metals and chemicals used on farms. Chemicals for crop spraying, which can cost more than £600 for 10 litres, are believed to be targeted by organised gangs who export them to meet demand elsewhere in Europe. NFU Mutual suggests that difficult economic conditions and rising commodity prices are contributing to increased rural crime. Lindsay Sinclair, Group Chief Executive of NFU Mutual, said: 'The countryside has long been seen as an easy target for criminals. Encouragingly, country people are fighting back with both high-tech security and creative solutions.'

Un sondaggio della compagnia assicurativa NFU Mutual ha rilevato che i lama sono tra le misure di sicurezza più insolite adottate dai suoi membri per la protezione dei beni di valore. Lo scorso anno, i furti nelle fattorie del Regno Unito sono costati 52,7 milioni di sterline, con un aumento annuo del sei per cento secondo la compagnia. Altri metodi improvvisati per mettere in sicurezza le aziende agricole includono l’allevamento di rumorose oche per allertare i proprietari e la sistemazione di costose attrezzature, come i quad, in recinti protetti da tori frisoni. article_content: Chip Wilson, founder of Lululemon, has been living with a rare muscular disease for several decades and is committing $100 million of his fortune to seek a cure. Wilson was diagnosed with facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) in 1987 at age 32, reports Bloomberg. The disease leads to progressive skeletal muscle loss and impacts just under 900,000 people worldwide, according to the FSHD Society. Wilson's particular diagnosis, a more uncommon subtype known as FSHD2, accounts for only 5% of all FSHD cases, or roughly 43,000 individuals globally, according to Bloomberg. Following his diagnosis, Wilson remained active for many years. However, he experienced a turning point decades later when struggling to walk while finalizing a business deal with China's largest athletic-apparel maker, Anta Sports Products, which was acquiring a stake in Finnish sports company Amer Sports. By 2022, Wilson had launched Solve FSHD, a venture philanthropy fund with a goal to find a cure for FSHD by 2027, as outlined on its website. The initiative especially targets new therapies for FSHD2 and has already invested nearly $31 million in biotech companies focused on various treatment approaches. Wilson believes that wealthy entrepreneurs can make a significant impact in driving medical innovation, citing their ability to attract talent and prioritize results. He told Bloomberg that in his view, capitalism 'created everything good in the world.' In addition, Wilson has tried several experimental and wellness treatments, such as electroacupuncture, IV infusions of NAD (an enzyme critical for cellular health), weekly rapamycin (an immunosuppressant), and daily testosterone, Bloomberg reports. Solve FSHD did not immediately answer Insider's request for comment.

article_content: UK families are potentially wasting up to £86 each year on electricity bills by leaving gadgets on standby or plugged in when not in use, according to a recent study. Researchers found that not switching off computers, televisions, and other electronic devices can account for up to 16% of the average electricity bill. While many people leave devices running when not using them, the study also suggests that individuals spend an average of six hours a day watching TV—an hour more than previously estimated. The research, conducted by the Energy Saving Trust in collaboration with government departments, reveals that UK households collectively could be losing £1.3 billion annually due to unused, powered devices. Monitoring 250 homes, the study recorded households spending between £50 and £86 a year on gadgets left in 'non-active' or standby mode, equating to 9-16% of their annual electricity bill. Households, on average, were running five and a half laundry loads per week, with tumble dryers used for 80% of these cycles. Running washing machines and tumble dryers costs families about £80 a year, not including materials such as detergent and softeners. Dishwashers were found to consume nearly twice as much electricity as washing machines. Home computer usage costs an average of £35 per year, and laptops are significantly cheaper to operate than desktop computers. The average household spends about £68 annually powering consumer electronics, including TVs, DVD players, and radios, while those with advanced 'home cinema' setups may spend over £300 a year. Single-person households may use just as much, or even more, electricity for cooking and laundry as family households, which could challenge energy reduction efforts if more people live alone. Nearly 29% of homes in 2010 were inhabited by a single person. Energy Saving Trust chief executive Philip Sellwood emphasized the importance of informed choices regarding energy efficiency and noted ongoing efforts to label energy-saving appliances for consumers. The government is working with the EU to ensure energy efficiency labels appear on all new appliances. The monitored group of homes used approximately 10% more energy than the UK average, despite claims from residents that they were energy-conscious. Home energy use accounts for over a quarter of the UK's carbon emissions. Environment Minister Lord Taylor and Energy and Climate Change Minister Greg Barker both stressed the need for greater efficiency and simple actions like turning off unused devices, which could save households up to £85 each year while reducing carbon emissions.

I ricercatori hanno scoperto che non spegnere computer, televisori e altri dispositivi elettronici può rappresentare fino al 16% della bolletta media. Molte persone lasciano dispositivi accesi anche quando non li usano; lo studio indica inoltre che si trascorrono in media sei ore al giorno davanti alla TV, ovvero un’ora in più rispetto alle stime precedenti. La ricerca, condotta da Energy Saving Trust e da dipartimenti governativi, rivela che le famiglie britanniche potrebbero perdere complessivamente 1,3 miliardi di sterline all’anno a causa dei dispositivi lasciati collegati inutilmente. Monitorando 250 case, lo studio ha rilevato che le famiglie spendono tra 50 e 86 sterline all’anno per dispositivi lasciati in modalità standby o inattiva, pari al 9-16% della bolletta annuale. In media, le famiglie effettuano cinque e mezzo lavaggi a settimana, utilizzando l’asciugatrice nell’80% dei casi. Lavatrice e asciugatrice costano circa 80 sterline all’anno, escluse le spese per detersivi e ammorbidenti. Le lavastoviglie consumano quasi il doppio dell’elettricità delle lavatrici. L’utilizzo domestico del computer costa in media 35 sterline l’anno, e i portatili sono molto più economici rispetto ai desktop. In media, una famiglia spende circa 68 sterline all’anno per alimentare elettronica di consumo come TV, lettori DVD e radio; i sistemi ‘home cinema’ avanzati possono superare le 300 sterline all’anno. Le case abitate da una sola persona possono consumare quanto, o persino più, di quelle familiari per cucina e bucato, il che può complicare gli sforzi di riduzione se i single aumentano. Quasi il 29% delle abitazioni nel 2010 era occupato da una sola persona. Philip Sellwood, direttore dell’Energy Saving Trust, ha sottolineato l’importanza di scelte informate sull’efficienza energetica, citando iniziative per etichettare gli elettrodomestici efficienti. Il governo collabora con l’UE per garantire che le etichette di efficienza energetica siano esposte su tutti i nuovi apparecchi. Il campione monitorato ha usato circa il 10% in più di energia rispetto alla media nazionale, nonostante si dichiarassero attenti ai consumi. Il consumo domestico rappresenta oltre un quarto delle emissioni di carbonio del Regno Unito. Lord Taylor, ministro dell’Ambiente e Greg Barker, ministro per l’Energia, hanno sottolineato l’importanza di maggiore efficienza e di piccoli gesti come spegnere i dispositivi inutilizzati, che possono far risparmiare fino a 85 sterline all’anno e ridurre le emissioni.

article_content: Lorry Newhouse, previously engaged in painting and film (she studied film at Yale), entered the fashion world by founding her namesake label just a year ago, driven by her passion for color and textile. Although she is married to Mark Newhouse—a newspaper executive and cousin to Condé Nast’s CEO—Lorry states her family ties have offered little business advantage, with only limited media interest coming from within her family’s publishing empire. Her label has carved out an identity rooted in luxurious, dramatic eveningwear crafted in New York. Newhouse’s creative process centers on the tactile qualities and aesthetics of fine fabrics sourced from Italy and France, often selecting luminous, textured materials such as sequins, metallics, and brocades. This approach defines her signature uptown, sophisticated style of cocktail attire. Within her first year, her garments have gained attention from celebrities including Lana Del Rey, Barbra Streisand, and Alyssa Milano. Ireland Baldwin wore one of her dresses for a magazine feature. The Spring 2014 collection, launched at New York Fashion Week, showcases vivid taffetas, watercolor prints, and sequined pieces, all inspired by the glamorous yet classic look championed by Norman Norell. Defying fashion industry norms that prioritize youth, Newhouse (who is over thirty) prefers to work with friends and family as lookbook models. She acknowledges that running a fashion label is demanding, so she intentionally limits her business to maintain quality, mostly serving private clients and select boutiques. She prioritizes establishing a reputation in eveningwear before considering expansion into everyday clothing. Newhouse stresses that her venture is wholly her own, strictly separating business from her influential family; she believes personal integrity and hard work, rather than connections, are the foundation for building her brand.
translated_content: Lorry Newhouse, precedentemente impegnata nella pittura e nel cinema (ha studiato cinema a Yale), è entrata nel mondo della moda fondando la propria etichetta solo un anno fa, guidata dalla passione per il colore e i tessuti. Sebbene sia sposata con Mark Newhouse—un dirigente editoriale e cugino del CEO di Condé Nast—Lorry afferma che i legami familiari le hanno offerto pochi vantaggi commerciali, con un interesse mediatico limitato anche nell’impero editoriale della famiglia. Il suo marchio si distingue per abiti da sera lussuosi e scenografici, realizzati a New York. Il processo creativo della Newhouse ruota attorno alle qualità tattili ed estetiche dei tessuti pregiati importati da Italia e Francia, come paillettes, tessuti metallici e broccati. Questo approccio definisce il suo stile sofisticato ed elegante per abiti da cocktail. Nel suo primo anno, le sue creazioni hanno attirato l’attenzione di celebrità come Lana Del Rey, Barbra Streisand e Alyssa Milano. Ireland Baldwin ha indossato un suo abito per un servizio fotografico su una rivista. La collezione primavera 2014, presentata alla New York Fashion Week, propone taffetà dai colori vivaci, stampe acquerello e molti capi con paillettes, tutti ispirati al glamour classico di Norman Norell. Sfida le convenzioni del settore, che privilegia la giovinezza, e preferisce usare amiche e parenti come modelle per i suoi lookbook. Riconosce che gestire un marchio di moda è impegnativo; per mantenere la qualità, mantiene intenzionalmente la sua attività limitata, rivolgendosi soprattutto a clienti privati e boutique selezionate. Intende affermarsi negli abiti da sera prima di espandersi nell’abbigliamento quotidiano. La Newhouse sottolinea che il progetto è totalmente suo, separando nettamente il lavoro dagli importanti legami familiari; ritiene che integrità personale e duro lavoro, più che le conoscenze, siano le basi per il successo del brand.

article_content: A South African news presenter was dismissed after delivering an explicit on-air tirade during a live broadcast. Mark Esterhuysen, 23, was removed from his position at Johannesburg-based 702 Talk Radio after using strong language thirteen times in a forty-second outburst at 1am. Esterhuysen's commentary, which began with a standard news introduction, soon escalated into a furious outpouring directed at multiple targets, including police accused of killing Andries Tatane, controversial politician Julius Malema, and the right-wing Afrikaner AWB party. He also criticized racism, capitalism, fascism, wage conditions, state authority, and economic growth at the expense of the environment. During his statement, producers attempted to mask the profanity with background music, but Esterhuysen persisted, urging listeners to visit his blog and social media profiles before leaving the studio. His employer confirmed his immediate dismissal and issued an apology to listeners, stressing that Esterhuysen's comments did not reflect the station's views. Esterhuysen, who previously worked in student radio, describes himself online as an 'enemy of the state' and 'defender of anarchy'. The reference to Andries Tatane relates to a black teacher whose death at the hands of police during an April protest sparked nationwide outrage and led to murder charges against six officers.

Il suo intervento, iniziato con una normale presentazione, è presto degenerato in un acceso sfogo contro vari bersagli: poliziotti accusati della morte di Andries Tatane, il politico controverso Julius Malema e il partito di destra Afrikaner AWB. Ha inoltre criticato razzismo, capitalismo, fascismo, condizioni di lavoro, autorità statale e la crescita economica a discapito dell'ambiente. Durante la dichiarazione, i produttori hanno tentato di coprire le volgarità con musica, ma Esterhuysen ha continuato, invitando gli ascoltatori a seguire il suo blog e i suoi social prima di lasciare lo studio. Il datore di lavoro ha confermato il licenziamento immediato e si è scusato con il pubblico, precisando che le opinioni espresse non rispecchiano quelle dell’emittente. Esterhuysen, ex conduttore radiofonico universitario, si definisce online 'nemico dello stato' e 'difensore dell’anarchia'. Il riferimento a Andries Tatane riguarda un insegnante ucciso dalla polizia durante una protesta ad aprile, evento che ha suscitato indignazione nazionale e portato all’incriminazione di sei agenti per omicidio.

article_content: Musicians branching into fragrance are shaking up the perfume industry, with several stars now outselling established brands. Perfumes by celebrities such as Britney Spears, Beyoncé, and Cheryl Fernandez-Versini are now topping popular brands like Hugo Boss and Gucci in some stores. At UK retailer Superdrug, Britney Spears's fragrances outsell DKNY by three to one and Hugo Boss by two to one. Since her first perfume launch in 2004, Spears has sold upwards of two million bottles. She has built a reputation as the queen of celebrity scents, uniquely making it into every one of Superdrug's annual top ten bestseller lists since 2006. Her line is also among the more affordable options, with prices around £15 for 100ml. Still, competition is rising among celebrity perfumers. Jay Z’s GOLD currently leads in sales, beating Lacoste’s Red by threefold; Beyoncé’s Rise follows, outselling Gucci’s Envy by three to one. Cheryl Fernandez-Versini’s Stormflower is projected to outperform Marc Jacobs’ Daisy. One Direction’s You & I is outselling Calvin Klein’s Eternity, Katy Perry’s Royal Revolution is ahead of Dolce & Gabbana’s Light Blue, Rihanna’s Rogue surpasses Issey Miyake, and Lady Gaga’s Eau de Gaga tops Jean Paul Gaultier’s sales. Despite this wave of celebrity fragrances, Spears remains the standout for longevity and consistent high sales. She has introduced 16 different scents, including Curious and Naughty & Nice Remix. Simon Comins, Superdrug’s Buying Director, credits her unique staying power in the celebrity fragrance business, noting that while others like Naomi Campbell, Cindy Crawford, and Colleen Rooney have charted, Spears is the only celebrity who has continually placed in the official charts every year since 2006.

Inoltre, la sua linea è una delle più convenienti, con prezzi attorno a 15 sterline per 100 ml. Tuttavia, la concorrenza tra le star produttrici di profumi è sempre più agguerrita. Attualmente, GOLD di Jay Z guida le vendite, superando Red di Lacoste di tre volte; segue Rise di Beyoncé, che supera Envy di Gucci tre a uno. Nonostante questa ondata di profumi delle celebrità, Spears svetta per costanza e vendite elevate. Ha lanciato 16 fragranze, tra cui Curious e Naughty & Nice Remix. The Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial on Washington, D.C.'s National Mall will be ready for this month’s events commemorating the 50th anniversary of Dr. King’s famous “I Have a Dream” speech. Sandblasting work on the monument was completed Thursday night, following delays caused by a contractor lacking proper insurance. Eventually, the National Park Service’s Historic Preservation Training Center completed the project, according to spokesperson Carol Johnson. She noted that the Park Service, which initially did not anticipate the need for sandblasting, is “very happy” with the finished work. Remaining scaffolding is expected to be removed in the coming days.

The completion of this work comes after the removal of a controversial inscription. The memorial originally featured a paraphrased quote from Dr. King’s “Drum Major” speech: “I was a drum major for justice, peace and righteousness.” In 2011, poet and King’s friend Maya Angelou criticized this paraphrase, saying it took King’s words out of context and made him seem arrogant. The accurate quote, delivered two months before King’s assassination in 1968, was: “If you want to say that I was a drum major, say that I was a drum major for justice. Say that I was a drum major for peace. I was a drum major for righteousness. And all of the other shallow things will not matter.”

Bob Vogel, superintendent of the National Mall and Memorial Parks, stated that the restoration project is expected to cost between $700,000 and $800,000. The funding comes from a dedicated repair fund rather than taxpayer money. The memorial, designed by Chinese artist Lei Yixin, opened in the summer of 2011. Its centerpiece is a large statue of King carved into the “Stone of Hope,” which appears to emerge from the “Mountain of Despair.” King gave his iconic “I Have a Dream” speech at the Lincoln Memorial on August 28, 1963.

Il Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial sul National Mall di Washington, D.C. sarà pronto per gli eventi di questo mese che celebrano il 50º anniversario del celebre discorso “I Have a Dream” di King. Il lavoro di sabbiatura sul monumento è terminato giovedì sera, dopo ritardi dovuti alla mancanza di una giusta assicurazione da parte di un appaltatore. Alla fine, il Centro di Formazione per la Conservazione Storica del National Park Service ha concluso il progetto, come riferito dalla portavoce Carol Johnson. Johnson ha sottolineato che il Park Service, che inizialmente non prevedeva la necessità della sabbiatura, è “molto soddisfatto” del risultato. Le ultime impalcature saranno rimosse nei prossimi giorni.

Il completamento di questi lavori segue la rimozione di una citazione controversa. Inizialmente, il memoriale riportava una parafrasi dal discorso “Drum Major” di King: “Ero un tamburino per la giustizia, la pace e la rettitudine”. Nel 2011, la poetessa e amica di King, Maya Angelou, criticò questa versione, affermando che aveva estrapolato le parole di King dal contesto e lo faceva sembrare arrogante. La frase originale, pronunciata due mesi prima dell’assassinio di King nel 1968, era: “Se volete dire che ero un tamburino, dite che ero un tamburino per la giustizia. Dite che ero un tamburino per la pace. Ero un tamburino per la rettitudine. E tutte le altre cose superficiali non avranno importanza.”

Bob Vogel, sovrintendente del National Mall e Memorial Parks, ha riferito che il restauro dovrebbe costare tra i 700.000 e gli 800.000 dollari. I fondi provengono da una raccolta dedicata alle riparazioni e non dai contribuenti. Il memoriale, progettato dall’artista cinese Lei Yixin, è stato inaugurato nell’estate del 2011. Il pezzo centrale è una grande statua di King scolpita nella “Stone of Hope”, che sembra emergere dalla “Mountain of Despair”. King pronunciò il suo iconico discorso “I Have a Dream” al Lincoln Memorial il 28 agosto 1963.
